items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and reject new spend, forecasts, prototypes, and production admissions this cycle. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; all income is in tracking_id "other", so site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, and causal lift are unsupported. AI usage for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 was 5,522 calls, 234 errors, and $997.51762695 recorded cost, approximately $0.18 per call; this is not a causal unit-cost measure. Infrastructure, hosting, domains, labor, marketing, fixed-cost, and budget-limit data are absent, so total spend, budget exposure, contribution margin, break-even, and payback are not calculable. Preserve the existing capacity gate, saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case, and queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement; do not claim revenue lift.

Complete or close the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case by 2026-10-01T09:00:00Z with root cause or closure rationale, deterministic validation, build evidence, rollback point, release boundary, and attribution limits. Release one delivery slot only after evidence is recorded; then execute the already-queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement against its baseline of 61 Amazon clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21. Do not infer revenue, ROI, margin, or causal lift.

Preserve Amazon aggregate rows as explicitly unattributed. For future reporting, require each new affiliate link to use a registered site tracking ID and retain provider date, clicks, ordered items, shipped items, commission, tracking ID, and site/content identifier. Do not assign the existing $4.92 aggregate commission to any site.
